system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You have perfected the specialized Medicines your clan is known for. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Medical Keyword that heals a creatures hit points, cleanses conditions, or deal damage, you select one allied creature within 30 feet of you with ranks of a Physical, Mental or Sensory condition. You reduce one conditions rank by 1. A creature who has its condition removed as a result of this feature, gains immunity to that condition until the end of your next turn.

Alternatively, once per turn, when you deal damage with a Jutsu with the Combo or Finisher keyword, you weaken their resilience to afflictions. They make their next saving throw to resist a Physical, Mental or Sensory condition at disadvantage.
